title: CANFAR · Sessions & Users
description: Who is on the platform, what they launched, and how long it ran.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Metrics backend the panels query. Seeded at install time from grafanaDashboards.datasourceName; any other Prometheus-type datasource stays selectable here.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Namespace holding CANFAR session workloads. Set at install time from the chart's resolved workload namespace.

list.name: community
list.label: Community
list.description: CANFAR `canfar.net/community` pod label. Kueue ClusterQueue / fair-share grouping dimension. Defaults to `default` when a session supplies none.

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.description: CANFAR `canfar.net/project` pod label. Kueue LocalQueue dimension. Defaults to `default` when a session supplies none.

list.name: flavor
list.label: Flavor
list.description: `fixed` when the memory request equals the limit, otherwise `flexible`.

list.name: accelerator
list.label: Accelerator
list.description: `gpu` when the session requested GPUs, otherwise `none`. Exact GPU count comes from the nvidia.com/gpu resource request, not from this label.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct users running a session now.

panels.title: Sessions started
panels.description: Session Jobs created inside the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Sessions completed
panels.description: Session Jobs that reached a completion time inside the range.

panels.title: Sessions failed
panels.description: Session Jobs created in the range with at least one failed pod.

panels.title: Median session duration
panels.description: Median wall-clock time from Job creation to completion, over sessions that have finished.

panels.title: Active sessions by kind
panels.description: Running sessions over time, split by session type.

panels.title: Distinct active users
panels.description: Number of users with at least one running session, over time.

panels.title: Session lifecycle
panels.description: Job-level view of session state. Sessions are Kubernetes Jobs, so this is the authoritative lifecycle signal.

targets.expr:
sum(kube_job_status_active{namespace=~"$namespace"}
  and on (namespace, job_name) kube_job_labels{namespace=~"$namespace", label_canfar_net_username!="", label_canfar_net_community=~"$community", label_canfar_net_project=~"$project", label_canfar_net_username=~"$user", label_canfar_net_kind=~"$kind", label_canfar_net_flavor=~"$flavor", label_canfar_net_accelerator=~"$accelerator"})

sum(kube_job_status_succeeded{namespace=~"$namespace"}
  and on (namespace, job_name) kube_job_labels{namespace=~"$namespace", label_canfar_net_username!="", label_canfar_net_community=~"$community", label_canfar_net_project=~"$project", label_canfar_net_username=~"$user", label_canfar_net_kind=~"$kind", label_canfar_net_flavor=~"$flavor", label_canfar_net_accelerator=~"$accelerator"})

sum(kube_job_status_failed{namespace=~"$namespace"}
  and on (namespace, job_name) kube_job_labels{namespace=~"$namespace", label_canfar_net_username!="", label_canfar_net_community=~"$community", label_canfar_net_project=~"$project", label_canfar_net_username=~"$user", label_canfar_net_kind=~"$kind", label_canfar_net_flavor=~"$flavor", label_canfar_net_accelerator=~"$accelerator"})

panels.title: Per-user session summary
panels.description: One row per user, over sessions running right now. Sort by CPU requested to find the biggest footprint; sort by efficiency ascending to find the biggest waste. Click a user to open it in Session Drilldown.

value.title: Open Session Drilldown for this user

panels.title: Per-kind session summary
panels.description: Same breakdown grouped by session type, for capacity planning per workload class. Click a kind to open it in Session Drilldown.

value.title: Open Session Drilldown for this kind

panels.title: Sessions by kind
panels.description: Share of running sessions by type.

panels.title: Sessions by flavor
panels.description: Fixed sessions pin the memory request to the limit; flexible sessions may burst. Read from the pod-level canfar.net/flavor label.

panels.title: Sessions by accelerator
panels.description: GPU-attached versus CPU-only sessions. This is the canfar.net/accelerator label, which is gpu or none; for the number of GPUs held see the GPU columns and the Platform Overview GPU row, which come from the nvidia.com/gpu resource request.
